svg.title: I. System architecture
svg.desc: RaceTime system component diagram. Streamlit submits account-scoped jobs to a SQLite-backed worker. LangGraph coordinates video inspection, semantic retrieval, cited synthesis and durable review. Gemini, storage, evaluation and optional deployment are identified, with validation limits.
svg.text: The local video product, its model boundary, persistent state and separate capstone components.
Public YouTube URL or local video
Save media; queue work; inspect results
State: question + media + start/end/as_of + selected + iterations
uses a rule, without an LLM call
Action must be in permitted set
Only called when there is a choice
falls back to a permitted action
Live stream integration: not yet tested
Full interval and cutoff checks at retrieval
Written by inspect; read by retrieve
interrupt() pauses for source verification; approve / reject records a decision.
UI calls Service.review() -> Command(resume=decision); thread_id = owner:job.
Result + evidence + trace export; clarification or failures can end without a recap.
Persists graph steps, not only approval
Resume is scoped to owner + job
SEPARATE SURFACES / these are not dependencies of a video recap
Offline router; not deployed in this graph
Local-first scope; no hosted service claimed
Solid arrows: primary calls / data relationships. Dashed arrows: conditional or fallback paths. Labels describe the implemented local design.
Validation status: 10 Sep 2026. Small-video integration is not real-race accuracy. Secrets and runtime data stay outside Git.
